title: Art. 9.1.1 — Annex 14 - Aerodromes, Volume I - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Chapter 9 - Aerodrome Operational Services, Equipment and Installations, 9.1 Aerodrome emergency planning, General, 9.1.1
content: An aerodrome emergency plan shall be established at an aerodrome, commensurate with the aircraft operations and other activities conducted at the aerodrome.
text: An aerodrome emergency plan shall be established at an aerodrome, commensurate with the aircraft operations and other activities conducted at the aerodrome.
